stem.text: The diagram shows the structure of an antibody.

stem.alt: Line drawing of a Y-shaped antibody with two circled tips at the top, a stem below, and labels X, Y and Z.

stem.text: Which statements about the antibody are correct?

items: X has a similar shape to the antigen.
Y is the hinge region held by disulfide bonds.
Z is a constant region which binds to receptors on B-lymphocytes.
